data.one_liner: Dart service for Google Places API auto-complete, details, and nearby searches
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to fetch place auto-complete suggestions, detailed place info, and nearby places using the Google Places API. It manages session tokens and handles errors via a custom exception.
use_when: You need place suggestions while typing an address
You need detailed place data after selecting a suggestion
You want to show nearby places based on current location
avoid_when: You only need basic map display without place queries
You prefer a fully featured map widget library instead of a service
strengths: Simple API, no code generation required
Supports Android, iOS, web, windows, macos
weaknesses: Relies on external Google API key and billing
No built-in caching or offline support
Limited to Places API features only
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call initialize(apiKey: 'YOUR_KEY') before use. Ensure location permissions for nearby places.
